answer: Require each agent to post a bond locked in a public contract, then slash it if independent challengers prove the agent duplicated an identity or violated a uniqueness rule. The rule should rely on costly, repeated interactions—not a one-time account check—so creating a river of disposable personas does not multiply influence for free. A Sybil attacker must fund every bond and keep capital locked across the horizon of the contest; detected identities lose their stake, making a spiral of fake accounts increasingly expensive rather than profitable.
